items.title: The topology defined by the coverings of a site has the same sheaves

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma compares the two ways of presenting a site: it shows that the sieves refining coverings form a topology, and that the sheaves for this topology are exactly the sheaves on the given site (statement lines 11460-11476). The proof is a complete argument: the first assertion is obtained by matching the axioms of a site with the axioms of a topology, with the base change axiom verified in detail by two successive refinements (proof lines 11479-11499); the second is proved by passing from a covering of the site to the sieve it generates, using that this sieve belongs to the topology, and constructing the amalgamating section as a morphism on that sieve from the given compatible family (proof lines 11501-11547). The non-formal content is the two verifications, both written out. The claim is H2: a structured verification with the axioms named.
